Yes, there is a guided tour panel visible on the right side of the screen. It shows the following elements:

*   **Progress Bar:** A horizontal bar at the top of the panel, partially filled, indicating the current position in the tour.
*   **Step Counter:** The text "**1 / 7**" is displayed below the progress bar.
*   **Step Title:** The title for the current step is "**One stream becomes two**".
*   **Content:** Below the title is a sub-heading "**The delivery arrives**" followed by a paragraph describing the synthesis gas entering the system and the mission to recover ammonia.
*   **Navigation Buttons:** At the bottom right of the panel, there are two buttons: a light-colored "**← Back**" button and a dark-colored "**Next →**" button.
*   **Close Button:** There is also an "x" icon in the top-right corner of the panel to close the guided tour.
